summary: Iteration 123 testing completed. All features verified: (1) JW SC Short-Close backend endpoint works correctly - admin-only (403 for non-admin), returns correct response structure, updates SC status to 'short_closed', protects GRN'd lines, and has re-call protection (400 for already short_closed). (2) JW SC Short-Close UI works - button appears for confirmed/sent/in_progress SCs, shows detailed confirm dialog, and updates status after confirmation. (3) Quotation + Add Customer redirect flow works - navigates to /customers?action=add&returnTo=quotation, auto-opens full Add Customer dialog, and returns to quotations with new customer preselected. (4) PO + Add Supplier redirect flow works - navigates to /suppliers?action=add&returnTo=po, auto-opens full Add Supplier dialog. (5) Cancel flows work - closing dialog returns to originating page without newCustomerId/newSupplierId params.

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed (carried over from previous iterations)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 123 verified: (1) JW SC Short-Close endpoint POST /api/job-work/orders/{id}/short-close - admin-only, returns {ok:true, released_operations:[], cancelled_pos:[]}, sets status to 'short_closed' with timestamps, protects GRN'd lines (received_quantity > 0), returns 400 for already short_closed orders. (2) Short-Close UI button appears for SC orders with status in ['confirmed','sent','in_progress'], shows detailed confirm dialog explaining consequences, updates status after confirmation. (3) Quotation + Add Customer flow: clicking + button navigates to /customers?action=add&returnTo=quotation, full Add Customer dialog auto-opens (with GSTIN, salespersons, address fields), after save returns to /crm?tab=marketing&sub=quotations&newCustomerId=<id> with new customer preselected in New Quotation dialog. (4) PO + Add Supplier flow: clicking + button navigates to /suppliers?action=add&returnTo=po, full Add Supplier dialog auto-opens, after save returns to /purchase-orders?newSupplierId=<id>. (5) Cancel flows work correctly - closing dialog returns to originating page.

jw_sc_short_close_backend.details: POST /api/job-work/orders/{id}/short-close endpoint works correctly. Admin-only (403 for non-admin), returns {ok:true, released_operations:[], cancelled_pos:[]}, sets SC status to 'short_closed' with short_closed_at/short_closed_by timestamps, protects GRN'd lines (operations with received_quantity > 0 are not released), returns 400 for already short_closed/completed/cancelled orders.

jw_sc_short_close_ui.details: Short Close button (data-testid='short-close-sc-{id}') appears for SC orders with status in ['confirmed','sent','in_progress']. Clicking shows detailed browser confirm dialog explaining: SC will be marked Short Closed, source MO operations without GRN will be released to pending, linked draft POs will be cancelled. After confirmation, shows success alert with operations released count.

quotation_add_customer_redirect.details: Clicking + Add Customer (data-testid='quotation-customer-add') in New Quotation dialog navigates to /customers?action=add&returnTo=quotation. Full Add Customer dialog auto-opens with all fields (Code, Name, GSTIN with Fetch, State, Contact Person, Email, Phone, Payment Terms, Address, Salespersons assignment). After saving, returns to /crm?tab=marketing&sub=quotations with newCustomerId param, New Quotation dialog auto-opens with new customer preselected.

quotation_add_customer_cancel.details: Closing the Add Customer dialog (via X button or Escape) when opened from Quotation returns to /crm?tab=marketing&sub=quotations without newCustomerId param.

po_add_supplier_redirect.details: Clicking + Add Supplier (data-testid='po-supplier-add') in Create PO dialog navigates to /suppliers?action=add&returnTo=po. Full Add Supplier dialog auto-opens with all fields (Supplier Code, Company Name, Contact Person, Email, Phone, Payment Terms, Address, GSTIN with Fetch, State, Lead Time, Rating, Status).

mocked_apis_note: GSTIN lookup endpoints run in SANDBOX mode - returns sample data for valid GSTINs
